issue_context.summary: Distinct FancyZones layouts can swap or mirror across matching monitors after sleep. A related open monitor-identity PR should be validated before starting another fix.
known_information: Follow-ups report matching displays on Windows 11 with AMD and Intel graphics, and another report mentions Windows 10.
The issue is open and unassigned.
PR 51017 provides concrete monitor-identity and saved-layout reconciliation changes.
inferences: Same-model identity confusion is a plausible fit for the swapping/mirroring subset, but slow or disabled monitor recovery can also involve the display stack.
